fresh_leads.qualification_text: Minimum Qualifications Our Early Careers programs are designed for students and recent graduates who are beginning their professional careers, generally within one year of completing their degree. Education Requirements Bachelor's degree, or candidate for Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, Math, or Statistics to be received no later than June 2027 Program Requirements Available to start the Program on July 26, 2027. Analyst positions are in-person opportunities, requiring employees to work in the office at least four days per week. Core Qualifications You have recent direct experience in data engineering, programming, and delivering scalable data solutions in work or school settings. You are proficient in cloud-native platforms and tools, including Hadoop, HDFS, Spark, Kubernetes, and ElasticSearch, to deliver high-performance data solutions. You have experience developing AI/ML models, with hands-on desire to use platforms like Palantir Foundry, Snowflake, and AWS SageMaker. You are skilled in programming languages such as PySpark, R, Spark SQL, Java, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with a focus on delivering efficient, well-documented code. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in a professional environment. Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail. Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. What you'll need to succeed AIG seeks candidates who have excelled in previous work experience, demonstrated outstanding academic and extracurricular achievement, possess strong analytical, quantitative and interpersonal skills, and are enthusiastic about the insurance industry. It is a plus if: You are passionate about exploring innovative AI and Generative AI technologies, using them to drive impactful solutions within large-scale enterprise environments. You have an interest in working with both internal and external teams to deliver best-in-class data engineering solutions, sharing knowledge and best practices across the organization. You are experienced in implementing code versioning processes and are committed to maintaining high standards for software development and project management. We also look for a diverse background of experience, culture and thought. Successful candidates typically have a global perspective and a team-oriented track record. Applications will be accepted through October 31, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage candidates to apply early. We reserve the right to close this posting prior to the application deadline based on application volume. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc. * Minimum cumulative GPA of 2.8 or higher (please don't round) * Must be willing to relocate to the Hodges, SC site for the co-op. Relocation assistance will be provided for candidates that reside outside a 50-mile radius of Hodges, SC ## Skills: * Understanding of phase gate project management tools and techniques * Experience working in a global business environment and with remote teams * Knowledge using ERP systems * Voice of the Customer (VOC) experience * CAD/SolidWorks/Inventor solid modeling experience and the ability to develop detailed 2D drawings with tolerance controls plus management of engineering documents via Engineering Change Order process * Experience performing various engineering tests and analyzing results * Contribute to team-driven product development projects with high level of personal accountability, and excellent communication skills * Adherence to Zero Incident Safety culture fresh_leads.title: Manufacturing Engineer Co-op - Spring 2027
fresh_leads.qualification_text: Basic Qualifications: • Actively enrolled in a bachelor's degree or master's degree program in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering. • Minimum of one internship or co-op experience or an equivalent of 3 months work experience completed at the time of this application. • Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc. • Minimum cumulative GPA of 2.8 or higher (please don't round). • Must be willing to relocate to the Sumter, SC site for the co-op. fresh_leads.title: New Grad Civil Engineer I
fresh_leads.qualification_text: What We're Looking For At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners. This opportunity entails being responsible for assisting in the production and modification of design calculations, technical reports, engineering plans and specifications for assigned projects. This position performs research, development, calculations, design and delivery in partnership with the project team. Applies engineering techniques, procedures and design criteria for projects ranging in size and complexity. Leverages technical knowledge to assist in the execution and evaluation of project designs. Develops conceptual and detailed designs and calculations to support the project execution using current drawing and technical tools, programs and software. As a member of the team, you will contribute to the successful project delivery for a diverse range of projects for HNTB's clients. The Houston office is looking for New Grad Civil Engineers to join either our Traffic or Roadway team. What You'll Do: Completes assigned work within the schedule and number of hours provided. Supports the preparation and modification of project reports, plans, designs, and calculations. Assists in the preparation of project quantity and cost estimates. Assists engineering teams with organization and administrative support of design files. Supports engineering teams with various tasks and duties including but not limited to research, data collection, field investigations, development, and design of projects. Performs other duties as assigned What You'll Need: Bachelor's degree in Engineering What You'll Bring: Exhibits an understanding of engineering principles relevant to the discipline. Attains knowledge of the Microsoft Office Suite, and familiarity with MicroStation and/or AutoCad or other software. What We Prefer: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering Engineer in Training (EIT) certification Knowledgeable in MicroStation and/or AutoCAD Previous internships and/or Campus Leadership Additional Information Click here for
